skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to observe, understand, and report on travel agencies, products, customers, organizational structure, and operations.
Students will learn to analyze travel agencies, their products, customer segments, and operational processes.
Students will develop the ability to write comprehensive reports based on observations and analysis.
Students will gain a deeper understanding of the travel industry's structure and operations.
Students will improve their observational skills by engaging with real-world business environments.
